notes.title: New Update
notes.notes:
Fishes now reacts to controller.
Seahorse from the first experience changed to swim around the player before leaving.
Menu has now both controllers support.
Seashell in the fourth experience is now always opened.
Minor bug fixes.

Oculus support coming soon!
